news.title: SLU Professor Named to Nursing Honor Society's Hall of Fame
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University Professor Verna Hendricks-Ferguson, Ph.D., has been inducted into the International Nurse Researcher Hall of Fame in Toronto, Canada, at Sigma Theta Tau Honor Society of Nursing's 37th International Nursing Research Congress this summer.

news.title: Jennifer Buehler, Ph.D.: 1970-2026
news.summary_en: Jennifer Buehler, Ph.D., associate professor of educational studies at Saint Louis University, died Friday, Aug. 28, 2026.
